livingIndicators.title: At least basic sanitation
livingIndicators.definition: Household members using improved sanitation facilities not shared with other households

source.evidence: Supplied PDF; official catalogue link is not a direct PDF link

livingIndicators.comparisonNote: Within-survey point estimates; differences not significance-tested. District confidence intervals not extracted.

cautions: MICS values are weighted household-survey estimates, not census counts.
Ten survey districts reflect the report geography; do not split estimates into newly formed districts.
Basic drinking water means improved source with collection time at most 30 minutes round trip; it is not proof of uncontaminated or safely managed water.
Basic sanitation means improved facilities not shared with other households; it is not safely managed sanitation.
Internet access is a household measure, not percent of people online or connection quality.
Wealth quintiles are relative within-survey asset groups, not income bands or poverty rates.
No longitudinal living-condition comparison is supplied because definitions and reference periods require harmonization.
